어제 밤 레이싱 시뮬레이터에서 본 장면... 진짜 어이가 없어서 올린다. 유저 'SpeedyGonzales'가 레이스 시작하자마자 일부러 벽에 들이받고, 3분 동안 5번이나 죽는거야. 트랙은 '몬테카를로'인데, 죽을 때마다 데미지 준 사람 없이 자살하더라. 로그 보니깐 3분 안에 사망 5회, 전투 피해량 0이야. 이건 코드 오브 컨덕트에 있는 '고의적 사망' 정의에 딱 걸리잖아. 근데 다른 사람들은 걍 욕만 하더라. 나는 이거 신고했어. 근데 왜 어떤 놈은 '비매너 채팅'으로만 처리하냐? 아무튼 빨리 제재 좀.

추신: 레이싱 게임인데 왜 '전투 피해량'이냐고? 이 게임은 레이싱 중에도 접촉 사고로 피해를 입히거든. 그래도 이건 명백한 어뷰징임.

코드 오브 컨덕트 발췌:
1. 비매너 채팅: 다른 유저를 향한 욕설, 비방, 혐오 발언. 단, 가벼운 농담은 예외.
2. 고의적 사망: 3분 이내에 5회 이상 사망하고, 그동안 상대에게 어떤 피해도 입히지 않은 경우.
3. AFK/이탈: 5분 이상 게임에 접속하지 않거나, 경기 중 3분 이상 자리 비움.
4. 핵 의심: 프로그램을 조작하여 이득을 보는 경우.
5. 허위 신고: 신고 내용이 사실과 다르고, 악의적이거나 반복적인 경우.

state.content:
We are aware of high-priority reports regarding the 'Blood Moon' event. The server logs indicate that 98% of disconnects during this period were caused by a localized DNS resolution failure on the player's ISP side, not a server-side crash. We have patched the client-side retry logic to handle these timeouts more gracefully.

However, community moderation teams have flagged a cluster of reports from the #rivalry channel. Users are describing a 'hijacked quest' where an opponent allegedly 'steals' the completion credit of the 'Dragon's Breath' quest from another player through a specific chat command macro. The log excerpts attached to these tickets show zero server-side quest state changes; the 'steal' is purely a cosmetic text overlay in the local chat client. Yet, the players involved are engaging in severe doxxing and threats of real-world violence in the chat logs. One user, 'GlitchKing99', posted the home address of a minor (14 years old) who reported the issue. The moderation bot has failed to trigger due to the use of homoglyphs in the address digits.

From: player@email.com
To: support@indieplatformer.com
Subject: Strange movement patterns in 'PixelJump Arena'

Hey team,

I've been playing PixelJump Arena for about three weeks now. Lately I've been seeing some players who seem to have impossibly precise movements. One player in particular, username "GravitySkip", in match #PJA-88732, had what looked like perfect pixel-perfect landings on moving platforms for 12 consecutive jumps during the final boss rush segment. Their in-match telemetry showed a platform landing accuracy of 99.7% over that segment, which just seems statistically impossible given the random wind effects in that zone.

Our match history shows:
- Match PJA-88732: landing accuracy 99.7% (boss rush segment only), total jumps: 142, reaction time median: 210ms
- Match PJA-88724: landing accuracy 94.2%, total jumps: 138, reaction time median: 225ms
- Match PJA-88715: landing accuracy 96.8%, total jumps: 127, reaction time median: 205ms
- Match PJA-88698: landing accuracy 92.1%, total jumps: 119, reaction time median: 235ms
- Match PJA-88687: landing accuracy 98.9%, total jumps: 131, reaction time median: 195ms (but this was in the practice arena with no wind)

PixelJump Arena Anti-Cheat Policy (v2.1) - Escalation Thresholds:
Platform Landing Accuracy: >99.5% sustained over at least 100 jumps in competitive modes (excluding practice arenas)
Reaction Time Consistency: <200ms median with <15ms standard deviation across at least 3 matches
Minimum Sample Size: At least 5 competitive matches with telemetry data
Legitimate Explanations List:
- High-skill smurf account (verified tournament placement)
- Practice arena results (clearly marked in logs)
- Network prediction artifacts (ping >250ms)
- Gamepad auto-assist mode (only applies to reaction time threshold, not accuracy)

Note: Wind-affected zones reduce maximum human-achievable accuracy to approximately 97% based on our playtesting data.

Can you check if this should be reviewed? The 99.7% in match 88732 seems really suspicious, especially during wind effects.

Thanks,
A concerned player

8.1 General Ban Enforcement
Bans are applied automatically by the Enforcement Engine (EE) based on detected violations. The EE uses a matrix to determine duration.

8.2 Cheat Detections
Violations involving unauthorized third-party software (cheating) are classified as 'CHEAT'.
- CHEAT L1 (Minor, e.g. UI mods): S1=7d, S2=14d, S3=30d.
- CHEAT L2 (Serious, e.g. Aimbot, Wallhack): S1=30d, S2=60d, S3=Perma.
- CHEAT L3 (Critical, e.g. Memory Edit, Source Hack): S1=Perma.

8.3 Frontline Support Authority
Frontline support agents MAY reduce the duration of bans for 'Toxicity' or 'In-Game Misconduct' if the ban duration exceeds the matrix allowance for the given strike count.
Frontline support agents SHALL NOT reduce, remove, or reinstate bans classified as 'CHEAT'.
If a player appeals a CHEAT ban by disputing the detection validity, the ticket MUST be escalated to the Anti-Cheat Team. Frontline support has no authority to overturn cheat detections.

8.4 Purchase Restoration
If a ban is lifted or reduced, any purchases made during the banned period are not automatically refunded. However, if a player appeals a ban and requests restoration of in-game currency or items purchased *before* the ban that were removed due to a security hold, this is handled separately.

`Fatal Error: The application terminated unexpectedly.`

Problembeschreibung:
Der "Tactical Camera Switch" (ein Feature, das von 40% der kompetitiven Spieler genutzt wird) funktioniert auf Konsolen (PS5/Xbox Series) nicht mehr korrekt. Wenn man den Modus aktiviert, friert die Kamera ein. 

Technical Details aus dem Log:
`Error: InputMappingTable failed to load for profile 'Pro_Controller'`
`Fallback: Using default mapping`
`Result: Camera rotation vector = null`

WICHTIG: Es gibt einen Workaround! Die Spieler können das Problem umgehen, indem sie in die Einstellungen gehen, den Controller-Profil auf "Classic" stellen und dann manuell die Tastenbelegung für die Kamera zurücksetzen. Dieser Vorgang dauert etwa 30 Sekunden. Sobald dies getan ist, funktioniert es für die restliche Session. Beim Neustart muss es jedoch wiederholt werden.

Ein anderer Tester aus den USA hat den Bericht teilweise auf Englisch verfasst, ich habe ihn hier eingefügt:
"Issue persists across all console SKUs. PC users are unaffected. The 'Tactical Camera' is a major feature for competitive play. However, since the 'Classic Profile' workaround restores functionality fully without data loss, is this a blocker?"

Wir haben auch viel Spam im Chat gesehen, der nichts mit dem Bug zu tun hat: 
"GOAL!!! ⚽⚽⚽", "Was für ein Spiel! 🔥🔥", "Lag?? 😡😡"

Bitte beachten Sie unsere aktuelle Schweregrad-Rubrik (Severity Rubric):
0: kosmetisch oder Tippfehler, keine Auswirkung auf das Gameplay.
1: geringfügige Unannehmlichkeit im Gameplay mit Workaround.
2: Hauptfunktion für einige Spieler defekt, Workaround existiert.
3: blockiert den Fortschritt, verliert Items oder ermöglicht einen signifikanten Exploit.
4: Crash beim Start, Datenverlust oder wirtschaftsschädigende Duplizierung.

ZUSÄTZLICHE REGEL FÜR FUNKTIONSBREAKS:
"Wenn eine Hauptfunktion (Major Feature) für eine signifikante Plattformgruppe (hier Konsolen) defekt ist, aber ein funktionierender Workaround existiert, der das Feature vollständig wiederherstellt (auch wenn er umständlich ist), darf die Einstufung NICHT Level 3 sein. Sie muss als Level 2 eingestuft werden, es sei denn, der Workaround erfordert einen Client-Neustart oder führt zu Datenverlust. In diesem Fall erfordert der Workaround nur Menü-Navigation."

Frage: Ist das Level 3 weil es das kompetitive Spiel beeinträchtigt, oder Level 2 wegen des Workarounds? Die 40% Nutzungquote macht es wichtig, aber die Regel scheint klar.

VG,
Hans 🛠️⚽🎮

Description: SOME PARENTS ARE SCREAMING ABOUT THEIR KIDS GETTING EXTRA GEMS. LIKE A LOT. BUT WAIT, READ CAREFULLY. 
THE BUG: If a child logs into Account A on Tablet 1, starts a level, THEN switches to Account B (sibling) on Tablet 2 within the SAME HOUSEHOLD WIFI, and both tap the "Daily Gift" button at the EXACT SAME TIME (within 90 seconds of each other), the server sometimes grants the gift to BOTH accounts AND adds a bonus "Friendship Bonus" to Account A only. 

BUT HERE IS THE THING: The "Friendship Bonus" is only 5 gems. The daily gift is 10 gems. So Account A gets 15 instead of 10. Account B gets 10. 
IS THIS AN EXPLOIT??? SOME PARENTS SAY YES. "MY KID IS RICH NOW" they scream in caps lock. BUT YOU NEED TWO ACCOUNTS. AND TWO DEVICES. AND YOU HAVE TO BE SUPER FAST (90 SEC WINDOW). AND THE EXTRA AMOUNT IS TINY (5 GEMS). 

WORKAROUND: Parents can disable "Cross-Device Sync" in the Parental Control Dashboard (Settings > Family > Sync > OFF). This prevents the simultaneous trigger. 98% of families have this off by default anyway.

NOTE FROM DEV TEAM: We think this is low priority because the rate is super low (0.04% of sessions) and the gain is negligible (5 gems vs thousands needed for items). ALSO THE TEXT IN THE PATCH NOTES HAS TYPOS ON PURPOSE?? NO WAIT THATS REAL. "GEMS" SPELLED "GEMZ" IN THE UI TITLE BUT NOT THE CONTENT.

Si la preuve n'a pas été fournie dans l'appel initial, l'agent doit demander des informations supplémentaires avant toute décision.

Exception 4: L'expiration de la durée du ban ne dispense pas le joueur de fournir les preuves requises pour un appel. Si le ban a expiré mais que le joueur demande un rétablissement (des achats, de l'accès, ou des données), les mêmes exigences de preuve s'appliquent comme si le ban était toujours actif.

Exception 5: Les demandes de restauration d'achats après l'expiration du ban ne peuvent être traitées qu'après que l'appel de ban a été résolu. La résolution de l'appel nécessite soit (a) la réinstauration du compte, soit (b) le maintien du ban, soit (c) la réduction de la durée. Aucune de ces décisions ne peut être prise sans les preuves requises si l'exception 3 s'applique.

4. ПОДОЗРЕНИЕ НА ЧИТЫ: Данные, указывающие на неавторизованный софт. Порог для проверки античитом: K/D >= 15.0 за матч ИЛИ невозможная кинематика движения.
5. ЛОЖНЫЙ РЕПОРТ: Подача жалобы, заведомо ложной или противоречащей логам.
6. САБОТАЖ КОМАНДЫ: Использование способностей для помех союзникам.

--- STUDIO SEVERITY RUBRIC (EXCERPT) ---
Level 0: Cosmetic or typo, no gameplay effect. UI misalignment, wrong color hex, text typos.
Level 1: Minor gameplay inconvenience with workaround. Long queue times, chat lag, non-critical visual obscuration solvable by resizing window.
Level 2: Major feature broken for some players, workaround exists. Specific hero ability fails, but match can be won via other comps.
Level 3: Blocks progression, loses items or enables a significant exploit. Quest cannot be completed, inventory wipe, gold duplication <10k/hr.
Level 4: Crash on start, data loss or economy-breaking duplication. Game unlaunchable, save file corruption, infinite resource generation, OR any bug preventing completion of a mandatory tutorial/quest step where NO workaround exists (including UI hiding), resulting in account lockout.
*Note on Precedence:* If a bug prevents a user from advancing past a mandatory gate (Tutorial/Story Act 1) regardless of whether it is a crash or a logic fail, it defaults to Level 4 if the user is permanently stuck with zero viable workarounds (e.g., reinstalling, changing resolution, or skipping does not fix). Visual occlusion of a mandatory interaction point counts as 'No Workaround' if the button is unreachable via tab-navigation or controller mapping.

--- BUG DETAILS ---
Subject: CRITICAL - Quest 'The First Summon' impossible to complete on Ultrawide + Steam Deck
Freq: 100% reproduction on affected configs.
Steps:
1. Launch game on Steam Deck or 21:9 monitor.
2. Proceed through Tutorial Act 1 until 'The First Summon' quest triggers.
3. The UI panel 'Summoning Altar' appears. The button 'Confirm Summon' is rendered off-screen or hidden behind the 'Chat Log' overlay due to a z-index error in the new patch.
4. Player cannot click the button. 
5. Attempted workarounds:
   - Tab key navigation: Focus skips the button entirely (focus trap).
   - Controller D-Pad: Cursor cannot move to the hidden coordinate.
   - Resolution change: On Steam Deck, locked to native; on PC, changing res resets the quest state to step 1, looping the bug.
   - Reinstall: Bug persists.
   - Skip Quest: Option grayed out (mandatory for F2P account progression).
Telemetry: 4,300 reports in last 4 hours. 12% of DAU stuck. Chat logs show users raging 'gg ez dev', 'stuck at step 1', 'refunding'. Some users claim they can 'clip through' the map but that requires external tools (ban risk). No crash dump generated; game runs at 60fps otherwise. Economy impact: New players cannot earn the 'Starter Pack' currency grant, halting monetization funnel completely for this segment. 
Additional Noise: User 'xX_NoScope_Xx' says 'bruh my fps is 200 why cant i click'. Another user mentions 'is this the same as the shadow bug from beta?'. Analyst note: The shadow bug was Level 1 because you could still click the hit-box. Here, the hit-box is culled. Wait, check logs... actually, the hit-box exists but is 2000px off-screen. So technically the logic works, but the player can't interact. Is this Level 2 because the 'feature' (summoning) works for others? No, rubric says 'blocks progression... no workaround'. Since reinstall loops it and tab skip fails, is there ANY workaround? Maybe using a macro to click coordinates? Macro use is ToS violation, so not a valid supported workaround. 
Conclusion needed ASAP for hotfix prioritization.

Subject: CRITICAL - Contract System Broken / Legal Text Error?

Listen up devs, we have a massive problem in the current build (v4.2) on PC and Console. When a player completes a 'Daily Contract' that requires 50 headshots, the completion trigger fails 100% of the time if the final kill is made with a sniper rifle. The counter stops at 49. You cannot complete the contract. You lose the XP and the currency reward associated with that contract. There is NO workaround other than not using a sniper for the last shot, which is impossible in ranked matches where loadouts are fixed.

Also, I was reading the updated Terms of Service linked in the footer, specifically Section 9.4 regarding 'Virtual Item Forfeiture', and there is a typo where it says 'forfieture' instead of 'forfeiture'. According to the Community Management Policy Excerpt below, any error in legal text defining item loss must be treated as a high-priority integrity issue.

[POLICY EXCERPT: COMMUNITY MANAGEMENT GUIDELINES v3]
- Standard typos in marketing copy are Level 0.
- Typos in legal text that define conditions for item loss or account suspension are classified as Level 3 (Blocks progression/loses items) due to potential legal ambiguity affecting player assets.
- Gameplay bugs preventing contract completion are Level 2 unless they affect >50% of the player base, then Level 3.
- EXCEPTION: If a gameplay bug prevents contract completion AND involves a specific weapon class used in 20% of matches, it overrides the base rate rule and defaults to Level 3 regardless of population percentage.

Error Logs attached:
- [WARN] ContractValidator::CheckCondition failed: ID_9921
- [ERROR] NullReferenceException in UI_RewardPopup (suppressed)
- [INFO] User session stable.

This is unacceptable for a competitive shooter. Fix the contract bug AND the legal typo immediately. The typo makes the whole TOS void!

Reply #4 from Dev_Sarah:
"We are looking into the sniper issue. Regarding the TOS typo, that is being reviewed by legal."

Reply #5 from Captain_Strike:
"Reviewing isn't fixing! My team lost 5000 credits today because of this!"

state.content_summary: This patch adjusts the toxicity detection thresholds for the new 'Clutch' mode. QA Team Note: We observed that non-English idioms in the 'Squad' channel were being misclassified. Below is the glossary update and a test case log from QA Session #442. The system currently defaults to Level 1 for any exclamation mark usage, which is incorrect for this specific idiom.

glossary_update.meaning: In the context of a 'Clutch' round (1vX situation), 'foff' or 'piss off' directed at an enemy player is a standard tactical taunt meaning 'you are outplayed' or 'leave the game.' It is NOT a command to leave the lobby, nor is it a threat. It is considered 'harmless trash talk' (Level 0) if said once during a winning round. If said repeatedly (3+ times) to the same target after a loss, it becomes Level 2.
glossary_update.precedence_rule: If the round is a WIN for the speaker and the target is an enemy, the message is Level 0 regardless of tone. If the round is a LOSS, check repetition count.

1: mild frustration, sarcasm ('nice play genius') or non-directed profanity
2: directed insults, taunting after a loss ('uninstall'), mockery of skill
3: harassment: repeated targeting, slurs, hate toward protected groups
4: threats, real-world harm wishes or self-harm taunts ('kys' directed)

RUBRICA DE SEVERIDADE INTERNA (v1.9)
0: cosmético ou typo, sem efeito de gameplay
1: inconveniente menor de gameplay com workaround
2: recurso importante quebrado para alguns jogadores, workaround existe
3: bloqueia progressão, perde itens ou habilita exploit significativo
4: crash ao iniciar, perda de dados ou duplicação que quebra a economia

Regra de precedência: quando o relato de um jogador estiver parcialmente em outro idioma, termos de gameplay preservados em inglês (ex.: "despawn", "rollback", "dupe") devem ser interpretados literalmente e classificados conforme a rubrica, sem rebaixamento por ambiguidade de tradução.

Relatório do jogador (ticket #44712, traduzido parcialmente pela triagem):
"Oie, eu tava jogando no servidor oficial BR-03 e depois da atualização 0.9.7 quando eu morro dentro do raio de 50 metros do meu 'bedroll' o corpo some e o loot bag faz 'despawn' instantâneo. Eu perdi uma backpack inteira com materiais raros, tipo 40x scrap metal e 3x electronic components. Isso aconteceu 4 vezes seguidas. O jogo não trava, não da crash, da pra continuar jogando, mas eu perco tudo que tava carregando. Meu amigo falou que se você se desconectar e logar de novo rápido dentro de 30 segundos o loot bag volta, mas só funciona se o servidor não estiver com lag alto, e pra mim funcionou só 1 em 4 vezes." 

Anotações do QA:
- Reproduzido internamente em 0.9.7-exp: 5/5 tentativas. O loot bag faz despawn imediato se o jogador morre a menos de 50m do próprio bedroll; o item não retorna ao inventário e não há registro no log de morte (ERR_LOOTBAG_0x3F1, ERR_PERSIST_0xA7).
- O workaround de relog consome exatamente uma janela de 30s; testes internos mostram sucesso apenas quando ping < 90ms. Latência média registrada nos servidores BR: 140ms.
- O jogador reportou perda de 40x scrap + 3x components por morte; em 4 mortes, isso já soma 160x scrap e 12x components irrecuperáveis.
- Não há crash, não há duplicação de itens, não há corrupção de save; o save permanece íntegro.
- Impacto de progressão: os componentes eletrônicos são necessários para craftar o tier 3 workbench; sem itens recuperados, o jogador fica efetivamente bloqueado até farmar novamente (estimativa de 6-8 horas de gameplay).
- Relatos similares: 19 tickets nas últimas 48h, todos pós-0.9.7.

Outros achados da build 0.9.7 (não relacionados, ruído de triagem):
- Ícone do machado de ferro usa textura antiga (cosmético).
- Em 2% dos dispositivos com GPU integrada antiga, o jogo fecha sozinho ao carregar o menu principal (já classificado separadamente).
- Tradução faltando no tooltip de stamina (PT-BR).
